first_playable.doc: First-playable flow (M2-FP-03; docs/kb/tech/first_playable_flow.md). field_battle: the scene BattleRequest opens and the party a field battle starts with when the request names none (active, reserve, rng seed). prologue: the cutscene the prologue plays and where it hands the party off. end_card: the minimum hold before ui_accept is taken, its fade-in, and the scene accept returns to (the title). haluna: what HalunaStory (game/flow/haluna_story.gd, M2-FP-04) plays in the playable zone: the cutscene on first arrival and its spawn, the field battle's return spawn, victory flag and escape spawn (M2-FP-05: the beach side of the trigger), and the scene the causeway-head trigger opens (Cutscene B on its placeholder set, then the end card). M2-FP-13: after_battle_* is B02 (the in-engine scene played once at that spawn on the first arrival after the tideline battle is won; the scene sets after_battle_flag), before_ending_scene_id is B05 (played at the causeway head before the hand-off), and overheard_hold_sec is how long an overheard bark's line stays up before the next (longer for a long line: overheard_read_cps, the reading pace it must allow) (the B03 fragments, which play as Rhen walks past without stopping him). first_verse: the fight Cutscene B's <<event start_battle>> opens (M2-FP-06): its party (Rhen, Asha and Toma, no reserve), the flag a win sets, and the scene after it (the end card). shell_shrine (M2-FP-16): the trial level the causeway head now opens (haluna.ending_scene), and next_scene, where its exit through the flooded door goes (Cutscene B). M2-FP-15 (B11): first_verse.after_location / after_spawn send the party back to Haluna after the Drownbell (instead of after_scene, which only the no-battle path still uses). haluna.night_*: once night_flag is set and sworn_flag isn't, an arrival plays night_scene_id at night_spawn under the night stand-in (night: the sun's energy and colour, the sky and ambient scaled down, warm lamps at lamp positions, the dock villagers gone home; until M2-ENV-02's real night light), with the cast placed by night_cast (x, y, z, yaw°) and night_marks, then hands off to night_end_scene. Once sworn_flag is set, barks play their night_barks variant. M2-FP-21: when B05 reports ending_decline_event (its "Not yet" choice), nothing is handed off: Rhen goes back to ending_decline_spawn, short of the causeway head, which stays armed. party (M2-CMB-07 follow-up; PartyJoins, game/flow/party_joins.gd): who joins Game.state.party_ids, with their starting gear: new_game on Game.new_game(), and joins[flag] when that flag is first set (Cutscene A sets ch02_met_asha: Rhen and Asha active, Toma in reserve; a list joins the active party, {party, reserve} places each; HalunaStory fills an older save's empty party from the same row, replacing haluna.party_after_intro).

prologue._next_note: The M2 review switch (Lead, 2026-10-24): the slice route, ch02/haluna at Beach, until the human signs off the M2 review; then Act I, ch01/oruvel_underway at Drop (M3-C01-02), together with end_card.next_location. The debug chapter select (F8) reaches Ch1 meanwhile.

end_card._next_note: M3-C04-04: next_location / next_spawn (a locations.json id and spawn) send accept on into the story instead of back to the title. Empty for the M2 review build; the Lead sets ch04/haluna_wake / NemeDoor once the human signs off the M2 review.
